product_summary: unitedglass.in (Indian entity, 'United Glass Inc', Delhi-NCR phone numbers 9811915658/9811765658) describes itself as an architectural glass fabricator. Homepage product menu lists: annealed (float/sheet) glass, tempered (toughened) glass, laminated safety glass, digital-printed glass, lacquered glass, etched glass, frosted glass, anti-lime glass, tinted glass, reflective glass, fabric/embossed glass, switchable glass, plus fabricated systems: shower enclosures, glass railing systems, office partitioning systems, glass floors. Note: unitedglassinc.com is a different, unrelated US glazing contractor (Minneapolis, MN) and must not be confused with this entity.
comment: Declared 700991 (unframed glass mirrors, not otherwise worked) is only partially consistent: mirrors are not listed anywhere in the published product range, so 700991 looks like a mis-declared/legacy code. The real range is architectural flat glass and processed glass: float/annealed and tinted/reflective sheet glass (7005), surface-ground/polished or otherwise worked non-wired glass (7007.19/7007.21/7007.29), toughened and laminated safety glass (7007.11/7007.19/7007.21), multiple-walled/insulating units if 'energy saving' units are supplied (7008), and fabricated articles such as shower enclosures, railing and partitioning systems (7013.99). Industry label 'Строительство и DIY' is a misclassification of the sector: this is a glass processor/fabricator serving construction glazing, not a DIY retailer. Trader signs: the site presents itself as a 'fabricator' but also runs 'Retail' and 'Wholesale' business lines and resells third-party systems (shower enclosures, railing, switchable glass), so a mixed manufacturer_trader role is likely. All product claims are taken from the company's own website only; no customs line, invoice or shipment record was available in this research, therefore the entire product range and the corrected HS codes are 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Per project rule 3 the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: company retained, code corrected to the factual range above.
